Partiful's mission is to cultivate friendships through social events.

We believe events are the most effective way to meet new people and make friends. Our product helps you throw incredible events, starting with memorable party pages that make it easy to plan & communicate with guests — download the app to see how it works!

We're building new ways to streamline planning, connect meaningfully in the real world, and make connections between friends-of-friends. Our ultimate vision is to power everything you do in-person with your friends, eliminating the friction of bringing your most memorable experiences to life. You can read more about our mission in The Washington Post, The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Atlantic, Wirecutter, and USA Today. Partiful was named Google’s Best App of 2024, a Finalist for Apple’s App Store Awards, and Apple’s App of the Day (awarded 4x). In 2025, we were named one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies, one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and named to Inc. Magazine's Best in Business List.

Our company is backed by top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Google Ventures, and advised by the founders of some of the most successful consumer social products ever made.

The Role

We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to build and lead a high-performing engineering org that can ship ambitious product outcomes with speed, quality, and accountability as we scale.

You’ll own the health, output, and growth
of the engineering team — making sure the right people are in the right roles, the management layer is strong, and recruiting, culture, and execution all reinforce each other. This is not
a “headcount first” role: you should be obsessed with motivating and getting maximum leverage out of the current team and be willing to make hard calls when needed. You set the pace by example
— willing to dive into the work, do what it takes during critical moments, and hold the bar high for yourself and the team.

What you’ll do

Build and lead a high-performing engineering organization that can ship ambitious product and infra work with speed, quality, and accountability
Partner closely with the CTO on technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap prioritization; balance short-term product goals with long-term scalability and reliability
Partner closely with the CEO & CTO to communicate company vision and strategy, ensuring the entire engineering team is highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals

Codify and enforce engineering culture and standards (speed, craftsmanship, ownership, resilience); make excellence the default via code review norms, postmortems, documentation, and technical design practices
Strengthen cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and Ops so engineering effort is tightly aligned to company goals
Establish and track key metrics for engineering velocity, quality, and recruiting pipeline health, and use them to guide decisions
Work "in the trenches" with the team: we're in the office 3 days a week, with occasional late nights to get the job done

What you’ll bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, with proven leadership of 15–40+ engineers in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment
Direct experience building and scaling an engineering org: hiring, org design, management systems, and performance management
A track record of driving operational excellence in engineering — predictable delivery, clear ownership, and high-quality output
Strong people leadership skills: you’ve hired, leveled, developed, and retained high-performing engineers and managers
Comfort making and executing on hard people decisions with clarity and empathy
Deep experience partnering with a founder/CTO and product leaders on roadmap, architecture, and tradeoffs
Strong recruiting instincts: you’re personally effective at sourcing, assessing, and closing top talent
Clear and concise communication; you create alignment, set context, motivate teams, and make decisions in the face of ambiguity
You’re energized by high-intensity, hands-on building — you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, live close to the work, and model the pace and standards you expect from the team

Background in consumer or highly product-centric engineering
Experience managing both product and infra/platform teams
Experience scaling teams in hybrid or in-office environments

401(k) with company matching

OneMedical membership, telehealth, and virtual mental health support
Commuter benefits & contributions towards fitness / wellness (e.g., ClassPass, Citibike)

A front-row seat at an early, fast-growing company that cares deeply about product quality, culture, and building something people love

Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full-service capital markets and asset & wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.

But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

We are looking for a Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead
with strong experience in systematic options trading
to lead our Options Engineering team.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. Leadership & Working Style

Strong team player with the ability to lead, mentor, and guide engineers

Comfortable making technical decisions under uncertainty
Demonstrates outside-the-box thinking while staying grounded in practical delivery

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
Role Overview

Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead a critical area of the application platform that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP).
Reporting to SVP Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core platform domains. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.
This is a deeply technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable platform capabilities at scale.
Platform Engineering Mission

Platform Engineering delivers the shared application primitives, services, and guardrails that enable product engineering teams to build consistent, scalable, secure, and reliable applications across ZMP.
The team's mission is to provide reusable platform capabilities that improve developer productivity while ensuring platform consistency, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability.
Scope of Ownership

Own multiple core application platform domains, which include, but not limited to:
Platform authentication and authorization
Account, organization, workspace, and tenant management
Notifications and messaging infrastructure
Shared application services and reusable platform primitives
Platform APIs, API Gateway and extension mechanisms
Common developer frameworks and platform tooling
Shared operational capabilities

The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for the architecture, implementation, operational excellence, and adoption of their platform domains.
Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned platform domains.
Translate platform strategy into executable engineering roadmaps.
Drive technical design for shared services, APIs, schemas, and reusable platform capabilities.
Review designs and ensure alignment with platform architecture and engineering standards.
Identify scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability risks.
Champion reusable solutions and eliminate unnecessary duplication across product teams.
Guide migrations, versioning, and adoption of platform capabilities.

Engineering Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing team of platform engineers and technical leads.
Coach and develop engineers through mentoring, technical guidance, and regular feedback.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering best practices within the team.
Foster a culture of operational excellence, engineering quality, and continuous improvement.
Balance new platform investments with operational responsibilities and technical debt.
Work with other engineering teams to champion the platform domains and their benefits, drive adoption of the services

Platform Delivery

Deliver platform capabilities that simplify and accelerate product development.
Partner with product engineering teams to understand platform requirements and improve developer experience.
Build self-service capabilities that reduce friction and increase platform adoption.
Measure platform success through adoption, reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.

Cross-Team Collaboration

Partner with Product Engineering, Data Platform, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, Security, and FinOps teams.
Coordinate delivery of initiatives that span multiple engineering teams.
Resolve technical dependencies and implementation challenges.
Drive alignment around platform standards and engineering best practices.
Communicate technical trade-offs, priorities, and delivery risks clearly.

Reliability, Security, and Operational Excellence

Ensure shared platform services meet availability, latency, scalability, and recovery objectives.
Embed observability, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational readiness into platform design.
Improve tenant isolation, workload fairness, and platform resiliency.
Partner with Security teams to build secure-by-default platform capabilities.
Drive continuous improvements in operational efficiency, reliability, and cloud cost optimization.

Success Measures

Success will be measured through:
Delivery of platform roadmap commitments
Adoption of shared platform capabilities
Platform availability, reliability, and operational health
Improved developer productivity and satisfaction
Successful migrations and retirement of legacy services
Team engagement, growth, and engineering effectiveness
Improvements in platform scalability and cloud efficiency

Significant experience building and operating large-scale distributed platforms or multi-tenant SaaS systems.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for platform, backend, or infrastructure services.
Strong technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and shared platform services.
Experience designing and operating highly available production services.
Experience partnering with multiple engineering teams to deliver shared capabilities.
Strong operational knowledge of observability, incident management, and production readiness.
Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and grow technical leaders.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Experience building marketing technology, customer-data, analytics, or large-scale SaaS platforms.
Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Iceberg, PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar technologies.
Experience implementing identity, authorization, multi-tenancy, API gateways, or workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal.
Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Experience driving adoption of shared engineering platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
About Athena

Athena (athena.com) pairs world-class leaders with elite executive assistants. It’s where some of the most powerful partnerships in the world get built.

Our clients are founders, executives, and leaders whose ambition exceeds their time. Athena is the first company to build a human-in-the-loop executive support system, combining trained Executive Assistants with market-leading AI to help them stay organized, follow through on priorities, and operate at their highest level.

Athena is one of the largest companies in this category, with 3,000+ clients and over $100M in annual run rate. Our clients include Uber, Shopify, and Goldman Sachs.

We are fully global, working across time zones and cultures. Joining Athena means creating something that fundamentally changes how people live and work and brings extraordinary achievement within reach.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for people who take their work seriously and want to get better at it.

You should be thoughtful in how you approach problems, willing to take ownership, and able to follow through without constant direction. You ask questions when something doesn’t make sense, and you care about getting the details right.

You should be comfortable working with people who have high expectations and limited time. That means being clear, responsive, and reliable.

We’re also looking for people who are interested in how this role is changing. The way work gets done is in flux between people, systems, and AI. We want people who are curious about that and willing to adapt as technology evolves.

You don’t need to know everything on day one, but you should be able to learn quickly and apply what you learn.

Role Overview

The Senior Engineering Manager, Platform will lead the team responsible for Athena's business-critical platform systems across sales, partnership operations, retention, Athena AI operations, billing, and internal workflow automation.

This leader will define technical direction, develop engineers and managers, and partner closely with Product, Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, Sales, and Athena AI. The role requires the judgment to balance near-term business needs with long-term platform architecture, reliability, and maintainability.

The team is building systems such as the Ops Platform, partnership case management and intervention workflows, AI-assisted document generation, onboarding and offboarding automation, shared identity and SSO, sales enablement tools, billing and referral integrations, and stronger monitoring and operational foundations.

What You Will Do

Lead and grow the Platform Engineering team: Manage, coach, and develop engineers and engineering managers; set clear expectations for ownership, technical quality, execution, and collaboration.
Set platform strategy and technical direction: Define the architecture and roadmap for shared business platforms, workflow systems, integrations, APIs, permissions, and automation capabilities.
Drive execution across critical initiatives: Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, Legal, Data, and Athena AI to design practical systems that reflect real workflows, controls, and edge cases.
Build reusable systems: Reduce one-off solutions by creating common platform capabilities for workflow orchestration, case management, reporting, role-based access, document generation, and third-party integrations.
Improve engineering excellence: Strengthen design reviews, testing, release practices, monitoring, incident response, documentation, and production readiness.
Own operational reliability: Improve alerting coverage, reduce production issue resolution time, and ensure the team learns from incidents and recurring support patterns.
Measure impact: Ensure platform work is connected to business metrics such as sales conversion, workflow completion, intervention success, operational effort, retention, and system reliability.
Communicate clearly: Provide concise updates on progress, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Qualifications

Leadership experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years managing engineering teams and at least 2 years leading senior engineers, managers, or multiple workstreams.
Technical depth: Strong background in backend, full-stack, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise application engineering, with the ability to guide architecture and make sound technical tradeoffs.
Platform experience: Experience building and operating business-critical platforms involving APIs, integrations, workflow orchestration, stateful business processes, permissions, and complex data models.
People management: Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining strong engineers and managers, including effective performance and career management.
Execution: Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration.
Product and business judgment: Ability to understand operational problems, challenge requirements constructively, prioritize based on impact, and connect engineering decisions to business outcomes.
Operational excellence: Experience improving reliability, observability, incident response, testing, release processes, and engineering productivity.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to senior stakeholders.
Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities, incomplete information, and high expectations.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading internal platforms, operations systems, CRM-adjacent products, case management, billing, or enterprise workflow products.
Experience with AI-powered products, LLM integrations, agent systems, or AI-assisted workflow automation.
Experience with authentication, authorization, SSO, role-based access control, and privacy-sensitive workflows.
Experience integrating systems such as HubSpot, Stripe, Google Workspace, DocuSign, or similar SaaS platforms.
Experience with workflow engines, state machines, event-driven architecture, analytics, and reporting on operational lifecycle data.
Experience in a high-growth, globally distributed, or startup environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Athena, we are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace environment. We provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and talents.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Enablement
jobs.description:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.

About The Role

Engineering Enablement helps engineering teams build faster, more safely, and with less friction. The team owns the tools, workflows, and platform capabilities that improve developer velocity, quality, and confidence across the product development lifecycle, with a growing focus on AI-native tooling. That includes Hinge's agent platform, the foundation for building and operating AI agents across the development lifecycle, alongside the CI/CD pipeline, developer-facing observability, and the tooling that makes spinning up services and internal tools frictionless.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Engineering Enablement within Platform. This role owns the team's strategy, roadmap, and execution while ensuring the work delivers meaningful value to engineering teams across the company. You will identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve how engineers build, test, validate, and adopt platform capabilities, and you will lead the team that turns those opportunities into durable systems and practices.

This is a hands-on platform leadership role with broad cross-functional reach. You will partner closely with product engineering teams and adjacent platform teams to ensure Engineering Enablement is building the right capabilities, driving adoption, and improving outcomes rather than just shipping tools.

Responsibilities

Lead the Engineering Enablement team strategy: define the highest-leverage opportunities to improve developer velocity, quality, and engineering effectiveness.
Own the team's roadmap and execution: make priorities clear, drive decisions to closure, and ensure the team is delivering against meaningful outcomes.
Build and improve the tools, workflows, and platform capabilities that help engineers develop, test, validate, and ship software more effectively.
Treat internal platform work as a product: understand user needs, shape the right solutions, drive adoption, and measure success through velocity and quality improvements.
Advance the team's AI-native bets: make Hinge's codebase and systems operable by agents, and build the validation infrastructure that lets faster development translate into faster, safe product impact.
Raise the technical bar on the team through strong engineering judgment, clear standards, and credible involvement in architecture and design discussions.
Grow and manage the engineers on the team, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and development of future technical and people leaders.
Partner across Platform and with product engineering leaders to make shared work legible, coordinated, and effective.
Represent Engineering Enablement clearly to the broader engineering organization: what it owns, what it enables, and how teams should engage with it.

What We're Looking For

A track record of leading engineering teams, or equivalent experience driving execution and technical direction as a senior technical leader.
Strong product instincts for internal platforms, with a clear focus on user value, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
Experience improving developer workflows, engineering productivity, quality systems, build and release processes, or related platform capabilities.
Strong technical depth across some combination of developer tooling, CI/CD, distributed systems, async and event-driven systems (streaming, workflow orchestration, queues), testing, or engineering productivity infrastructure.
The ability to balance near-term delivery with longer-term platform investment and technical quality.
Strong people leadership, including direct feedback, coaching, performance management, and development of engineers at different levels.
Comfort working across team boundaries and driving progress through partnership, clarity, and influence.
A practical, outcome-oriented mindset and a bias toward making engineers more effective through simple, durable solutions.

As a Member Of Our Team, You’ll Enjoy

401(k) Matching:
We match 100% of the first 10% of pre-tax 401(k) contributions you make, up to a maximum of $10,000 per year.

Professional Growth:
Get an annual Learning & Development stipend once you’ve been with us for three months. You also get free access to Udemy, an online learning and teaching marketplace with over 6000 courses, starting your first day.

Parental Leave & Planning:
When you become a new parent, you’re eligible for 100% paid parental leave (20 paid weeks for both birth and non-birth parents.)

Fertility Support:
You’ll get easy access to fertility care through Carrot, from basic treatments to fertility preservation. We also provide a stipend towards fertility preservation. You and your spouse/domestic partner are both eligible.

Date Stipend:
All Hinge employees receive a $100 monthly stipend for epic dates– Romantic or otherwise. Hinge Premium is also free for employees and their loved ones.

ERGs:
We have eight Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)—Asian, Unapologetic, Disability, LGBTQIA+, Raices, Women/Nonbinary, Parents —that hold regular meetings, host events, and provide dedicated support to the organization & its community.

At Hinge, our core values are…

Authenticity:
We share, never hide, our words, actions and intentions.

Courage:
We embrace lofty goals and tough challenges.

Empathy:
We deeply consider the perspective of others.

Diversity inspires innovation

Hinge is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe success is created by a diverse workforce of individuals with different ideas, strengths, interests, and cultural backgrounds.

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please let your Talent Acquisition partner know.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI — real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

What You'll Do

Lead a team of 6 engineers owning end-to-end observability across the company's infrastructure, including logs, metrics, traces, and event-based monitoring
Own the roadmap for our observability and cost initiative independently, no PM or TPM support, meeting directly with engineering managers across the company to identify pain points and design end-to-end solutions
Drive down time to detect and time to mitigate for production incidents across a system where a single request can traverse 60+ services
Extend observability coverage beyond our original food delivery systems into new physical domains, including autonomous mining transport, as the company's mission expands
Maintain and grow a highly cost-efficient observability stack (currently running at a fraction of comparable third-party tooling costs)
Represent the technical state of your domain in real time, speaking confidently to feasibility, scope, and timelines for any ask without needing to defer to others
Stay hands-on (roughly a third of your time), jumping in to unblock the team when needed, using AI tools to analyze issues and surface insights, without sitting on the critical path for delivery
Grow the careers of the engineers on your team while maintaining strong technical ownership of your domain

What We're Looking For

2+ years of experience managing and growing engineering teams, ideally within observability, platform, or infrastructure functions
Strong foundation in engineering architecture and design fundamentals, enough to evaluate your team's technical decisions and push back constructively, even if you're not the one architecting solutions day to day
Comfort operating without a PM or TPM, someone who can independently scope a roadmap, prioritize competing asks, and drive execution with high ownership
Experience with, or ability to quickly ramp on, our stack: Go, Azure/Azure Kubernetes, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry. Prior Go experience is not required

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our Mountain View office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $254,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
TAF Carbon has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about engineering and sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s materials.

We are seeking a Director of Engineering who has lived the journey from lab bench to production floor, to join our team working directly with the Director of Research and Development and the leadership team. You will lead our Process Scale-Up & Manufacturing effort, bridging between our world-class R&D scientists and the industrial manufacturing partners who will bring our carbon foam materials to commercial scale. This is a hands-on, technically deep leadership role for someone who finds equal satisfaction in rigorous process analysis and in building the systems and relationships that make manufacturing actually work. This role grows with the company. Near-term, you will be driving industrialization and process control. Over time, you will contribute to new product development from the process and tooling side, and to the early foundations of TAF Carbon's own manufacturing capabilities.

This role is part of the team that services the entire Endeavour ecosystem and contributes to the overall health and success of the organization.

The Director of Engineering needs to be agile, professional, and comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team. They are a born problem solver and highly self-motivated to identify and address engineering challenges.

TAF Carbon is highly selective about the people we bring on board because our ecosystem depends on it. Change happens quickly here, and we must maintain a strong team of honest, communicative, collaborative, open-minded, strategic, reliable, and driven team members. We seek ultra-creative performers with self-awareness, a sense of humility, and a hunger to make a positive impact in the world. Endeavour offers flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value. Our team is the heart of the ecosystem. We’re a diverse group of bright, passionate, dedicated people, working together to make a real difference. Are you ready to join the journey?

Key Responsibilities

Include But Are Not Limited To

Process Scale-Up & Industrialization

Lead the translation of laboratory and pilot-scale carbon foam processes into robust, reproducible industrial manufacturing operations to take our material through testing and certification, prototyping, and product commercial launch.
Hands-on engineering and problem solving in a fast-growing start-up environment.
Define and implement process control and improvement frameworks — including 6 Sigma, SPC and MSA — that establish and sustain process capability across manufacturing environments.
Drive continuous improvement in process efficiency, energy performance, heating uniformity, cost of goods and time to market.
Develop and evaluate innovative approaches to mold design, heating technology, and process configuration that enable scalable, high-throughput production.
Establish and maintain high engineering standards, including documentation, design review processes, and technical governance

Manufacturing Partner Development

Identify, qualify, and develop long-term technical relationships with external manufacturing partners.
Serve as TAF Carbon's primary technical interface with manufacturing operations, ensuring alignment on process requirements, quality standards, and scale-up milestones.
Collaborate with R&D teammates to translate research outcomes into manufacturable processes and clear manufacturing inputs, streamlined processes, to reduce time to market.

Team & Organization

Mentor and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and pragmatic problem-solving.
Support project planning, prioritization, and budgeting in alignment with organizational goals and timelines.
Partner with leadership on strategic product and manufacturing roadmaps across all phases of commercial development.
Model culture of demanding excellence, scientific rigor, problem solving and a daily irreverence to big company corporate culture.

Longer-Term

Lead engineering contributions to new product development and cost reduction from the process and tooling side.
Contribute to early planning and capability-building for TAF Carbon's future manufacturing assets.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships, supporting tailored product solutions and long-term partnerships.

Skills & Requirements

Education / Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering (or related field).
10+ years of progressive engineering experience in industry with 3+ years in a leadership or management role.
Demonstrated track record taking a material or chemical process from lab or pilot scale to industrial production — you have done this, not just supported it.
Deep working knowledge of foamed materials and the industrial processes used to make them: polymer foams, carbon foams, ceramic foams, or closely analogous materials.
Hands-on experience with mold design and molding processes, including thermal analysis, dead mass minimization, and scale-up.
Experience designing or improving industrial heating systems — convective, or other non-conventional approaches are a strong plus.
Experience working with toll manufacturers or contract manufacturers as a technical owner, not just a customer.
Proven expertise in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), and process capability (Cpk, Ppk) — you use these instinctively, not on request.
Expertise with Design of Experiments (DOE) for process optimization.
Experience with continuous or semi-continuous manufacturing line concepts (belt press, or equivalent) is a strong plus.
Experience with controlled atmosphere processing and/or high-temperature industrial environments preferred.
Experience in gas handling, exhaust treatment and waste heat collection and re-use is a plus.
Proven track record driving product qualification, regulatory certification and new product introduction.

Specific Skills / Abilities

You know the difference between a research result and a manufacturable process, and you say so when you see it.
Strong process and systems mindset — experience implementing design control, setting and meeting specifications, and moving product from lab to pilot to prototype to full manufacturing.
Skilled in partner engagement, technical presentations, and developing tailored engineering solutions.
Able to work at the bench and on the whiteboard for manufacturing line design the same week.
Excellent leadership, communication, and mentoring skills with a collaborative, hands-on approach.
Entrepreneurial drive: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and doing more with less.

Enjoy…

A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.

A flexible, autonomous work environment.

A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.

Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.

Growth and travel opportunities.

A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

About TAF Carbon

TAF Carbon develops ultra high end carbon based materials that compete with “ordinary materials” in the construction market and beyond. Our team of passionate change-makers want to leave the world better than the way we found it and work towards a future of Better Materials Everywhere. TAF Carbon prides itself on hiring talented, highly motivated people because that’s what our mission requires. To work at TAF Carbon is to know that you are part of something special—something bigger than yourself.

Today, we’re deploying solutions that are game changing, scalable and profitable, taking on challenges based on the needs of our clients and partners and of local and global economies. At TAF Carbon we combine the best of what technology and the natural world can offer in developing a truly game changing material. Are you ready to #JoinTheJourney?

.

Director, Head of Software Engineering

Job Description

HITT is seeking a Head of Software Engineering to build a modern, AI-native software engineering practice from the ground up. This is a senior leadership role for an engineering executive with a builder’s mindset: someone who has seen firsthand how agentic, AI-enabled development is changing the way software gets made — and who knows how to turn that shift into a durable advantage for one of the nation’s largest general contractors. They bring the vision, technical depth, and people leadership to define how software gets built at HITT as the firm scales.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Head of Software Engineering will establish HITT’s agentic engineering practice from scratch — setting the technical vision, standing up lean, agile product teams, and creating the standards, workflows, and culture that let small teams of AI-fluent engineers deliver high-quality software at a pace traditional development organizations cannot match. This leader understands that tools are only half the story: lasting change comes from people, and they will be as invested in recruiting and developing talent as in technology itself.

The Head of Software Engineering is accountable for the structure and growth of the engineering organization, the delivery of applications and platforms that serve HITT’s project teams and jobsites nationwide, and the development of a new generation of AI-enabled engineering talent — hiring builders who already work this way and training HITT’s existing developers in new methods. The role partners closely with senior leaders across the firm and serves as a visible champion for the responsible, high-leverage use of AI in how HITT builds.

Responsibilities

Agentic Engineering Practice

Design, launch, and lead HITT’s agentic engineering practice from the ground up, defining the operating model, team structure, and software development lifecycle for AI-enabled delivery
Establish standards, guardrails, and best practices for agentic development — including AI coding agents and assistants, prompt and context engineering, human-in-the-loop review, automated testing, and evaluation
Select, implement, and evolve the AI development toolchain (coding agents, LLM platforms, orchestration frameworks, and integrations), reassessing regularly as the landscape advances
Partner with the CIO on the enterprise technology, data, and AI roadmap, ensuring the engineering practice accelerates HITT’s broader digital transformation
Ensure the software the practice ships are reliable, fast, and usable in high-velocity, decentralized field environments with users of many backgrounds

Talent, Recruiting & Enablement

Recruit and hire engineers and engineering leaders who thrive in lean, agile, AI-augmented teams, and position HITT as a destination for top AI-native engineering talent
Design and deliver training and enablement programs that upskill HITT’s existing developers in AI-enabled development methods: from hands-on workshops and pairing to internal playbooks and certification
Build a deep talent bench and clear career paths within the engineering function to ensure succession for senior roles
Foster a culture of experimentation — fail fast and pivot — while managing risk responsibly

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

Bring structure, accountability, and delivery discipline to the software engineering function, balancing execution (≈60%) with innovation (≈40%)
Implement lean, agile delivery practices built on small batches, rapid iteration, continuous integration and deployment, and measurable outcomes
Engineer security, quality, and compliance into every product, in alignment with HITT’s zero trust cybersecurity strategy and NIST-aligned frameworks
Define engineering KPIs and provide ongoing transparency to the executive team on velocity, quality, adoption, and business value delivered
Leverage external partners strategically while avoiding over-reliance on consultants, building enduring in-house engineering capability

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

Serve as a strategic advisor to executive and operational leaders on what modern, AI-enabled software development makes possible for the business
Partner with operations, virtual design and construction (VDC), preconstruction, and corporate functions to identify high-value opportunities for custom software, automation, and agentic workflows
Represent HITT’s engineering practice externally, in recruiting, industry forums, and the broader technology community, to attract talent and partnerships
Champion responsible AI use, model governance, and data stewardship across the software portfolio

12+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams or organizations; experience building a team, practice, or product organization from scratch is strongly preferred
Current, hands-on experience with AI-enabled and agentic software development, including AI coding agents and assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), LLM APIs, agent frameworks and orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation practices
Demonstrated success recruiting strong engineers and training existing developers in new tools, methods, and ways of working
Proven track record leading lean, agile teams that ship, balancing innovation with operational discipline in a complex enterprise
Deep grounding in modern software engineering practice: cloud-native architecture, APIs and integration, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and test automation
Strong product sense and user empathy; experience delivering software for field-based or operational users (construction, engineering, manufacturing, logistics) is a plus
Executive-level communication and presentation skills; able to build conviction with C-suite audiences and translate deep technical topics for business leaders
Financial and vendor management acumen, with experience owning budgets and managing platform and tooling ecosystems

Used well, these tools can help engineers move faster with higher confidence. Used poorly, they can increase complexity, review burden, operational risk, and cost. This role will help Reddit build the path for agentic development: flexible enough for teams to experiment, opinionated enough to protect quality, and measurable enough to prove whether AI is increasing delivered value rather than just activity. Drive alignment across infrastructure, developer experience, reliability, security, compliance, product engineering, machine learning, and executive stakeholders. You will influence across organizations and create clarity across teams with different priorities and incentives.
Build engineering systems and organizational processes that help teams move from experimentation to durable adoption of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining quality, reliability, and operational safety.
Develop communication and enablement mechanisms that bring engineers and leaders along for the journey, including technical strategy reviews, working groups, training, documentation, rollout plans, and clear narratives that connect workflow change to business and engineering outcomes.
Build and operationalize measurement systems that distinguish real productivity from vanity metrics. Partner with engineering and data teams to define metrics such as design-to-test time, test-to-launch time, review turnaround, change failure rate, time to restore service, AI-authored code quality, AI-assisted pull request load, migration throughput, and developer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Head of Software Tools
jobs.description:
Turion is developing the critical infrastructure of the space economy. We're doing this by building vertically integrated hardware and software: DROID, our line of space vehicles, and Starfire, our software suite covering simulation, modeling, planning, and operations.

We're a group of people who fell in love with the future sci-fi promised us, and we're building it into reality. We build hard things. We build them well. And we're just getting started.

Turion is scaling toward production of tens of vehicles per month while running several vehicle development efforts in parallel, and the engineering practices that got us here will not get us there on manual effort alone. The Head of Vehicle Development, Software owns the software layer of how we develop vehicles: the tools, automation, AI, and data infrastructure that let a lean team design, analyze, build, and verify spacecraft at production rate.

You will turn one-off engineering analyses into push-button pipelines, wire our design and systems processes into a connected digital thread, and give every responsible engineer an unfair advantage. This is a player-coach role. You will set the vision and recruit a small, elite team, and you will ship code yourself from day one.

This is a full-time
, exempt position based on-site
at our Irvine, California headquarters.

Responsibilities

Own the roadmap. Define and drive the strategy for vehicle development software across analysis automation, design automation, systems and requirements tooling, applied AI, engineering data infrastructure, and compute.
Build the team. Recruit, lead, and grow the software engineers on this team, set the technical bar, and stay hands-on in architecture and code.
Automate analysis. Drive the conversion of manual thermal, structural, vibration, shock, and environments analyses into parameterized, repeatable pipelines with automated model generation, batch solves, margin tracking, and generated reports.
Automate design and release. Own CAD, ECAD, PDM/PLM, BOM, and engineering release automation, plus clean hand-offs to manufacturing and supply chain.
Systemize systems engineering. Stand up requirements, verification, budget, and trade study tooling so systems engineering runs on live data rather than static documents.
Connect the digital thread. Create a common data layer linking requirements, CAD and ECAD, analysis models, test results, and as-built vehicle configurations, giving one source of truth from concept through on-orbit operations.
Build the compute layer. Stand up the cloud and HPC infrastructure that simulation, data, and AI workloads run on, and keep cost per solve falling.
Prove the leverage. Partner with responsible engineers in every discipline to find the highest value automation targets, drive adoption, and measure and publish cycle time and quality wins.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
8+ years of software engineering experience, including building internal tools, automation, or infrastructure for hardware engineering organizations such as aerospace, defense, or automotive.
Expert-level Python, working fluency in at least one systems language such as C++, and strong software architecture fundamentals.
Hands-on experience automating commercial CAD, CAE, or ECAD tools through their APIs and scripting interfaces.
Enough depth in at least one engineering domain, such as thermal, structures and dynamics, orbital mechanics, or electronics design, to partner credibly with analysts and design engineers. You understand what the tools are computing, not just how to script them.
Experience with modern data and cloud infrastructure including databases and data modeling, services and APIs, CI/CD, and compute heavy workloads.
Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentoring, or direct management, and the ability to recruit strong engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a spacecraft, launch, defense, or automotive company that scaled production rate
Familiarity with PLM and requirements systems such as Teamcenter, Windchill, Duro, Jama, or DOORS
Experience with HPC or cloud batch compute for simulation
Applied AI or ML for engineering workflows.

Compensation: $200,000 to $225,000 USD annually

Employees may be asked to support alternate shifts, extended shifts, and/or travel during peak work periods.

ITAR Requirements

This position may include access to technology and/or software source code that is subject to U.S. export controls. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees. In addition to a competitive base salary and company stock, determined by factors such as job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and market demand, full-time employees are eligible for:

Equity: Receive equity in Turion Space, letting you benefit from the company's success
Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents.
Retirement Plans: Access to a 401(k) plan with a 3% Employer Direct Contribution to help you plan for your future.
Paid Time Off: Generous vacation days, personal days, sick days, and holidays to ensure you have time to recharge.
Parental Leave: Paid parental leave following the birth of a newborn or adoption.
Emotional Wellbeing: A no-cost Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your household’s emotional health and wellbeing.
Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing internal training, workshops, and courses to advance your skills and career growth.
Team Building Activities: Regular social events, team outings, and company-sponsored activities to foster a positive work environment.

We are dedicated to providing a supportive and enriching environment for our team members, recognizing that our collective success is built upon the well-being and satisfaction of each individual.

Turion Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Turion Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

for the Product Solutions division, based in Huntsville, AL
with an educational and/or DoW industry focus in the processes and procedures to manage multi-discipline engineering teams on advanced RF-based payloads & sensor systems through the product lifecycle within DoW-related programs.

TSC’s PS Division provides products and services in the areas of radar, communication systems, sensors, antennas and other electronics systems to the rocket/missile, radar/sensor system, communications, control systems, data acquisition, and signal processing markets. TSC has developed products ranging from board-level, application-specific-designs, to complete, turnkey radar and communication systems. TSC has established a state-of-the-art hardware capability that is well respected by customers in Government and industry.

TSC offers a professional working environment, a competitive salary, and an excellent benefits package. Come and join our team!

Responsibilities:

This position requires a flexible individual with experience in product development, demonstration, transition to production, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment.  This position requires experience leading engineering teams through the product lifecycle process to include initial concept development and prototypes through production transition.  The individual in this role will lead the continuous improvement around the engineering processes and industry-best practices to ensure consistency and compliance with the product-focused projects and programs.  The Director of Engineering works with business leaders, engineering staff, production, and product owners to conceive, develop, test, produce, and sustain products across multiple product lines.

Define, modify, and implement engineering development processes and best practices for the division that follow industry standards such as AS9100 and fit into TSC’s existing quality systems
Lead a multi-disciplined team of systems, hardware, mechanical, software, and firmware engineers to build complete solutions and products

Provide resources necessary to implement product roadmap features
Support the production team with resources to enable the successful transition of technology into manufacturing
Provide and support technical oversight of engineering efforts
Provide technical and career growth opportunities for the engineering staff aligned with the product business
De-conflict resources through collaboration with business leaders, product management, and engineering staff
Support quality team to enact continuous improvement of engineering processes

Required Qualifications: 

BS in Engineering and minimum 15 years of experience in DoD industry
US Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.
Experience with the following:
5+ years management of multi-disciplinary engineering team
Product deliveries and support to USG and FVEY partners
Operating within AS9100 or ISO9001 business management structure
Demonstrated technical leadership and subject matter expertise.
Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying engineering processes and practices

Possess excellent organizational and communications skills.
Able to prioritize work and maximize productivity.
Experience with radar, SIGINT, and/or electronic warfare product development
Engineering development experience in electrical, mechanical, or software engineering
Experience managing resources across different geographical areas.
Experience working in both DoW and commercial industry.
Experience in qualifying and transitioning a design/product from engineering to production.
Experience developing, improving engineering and engineering management processes.

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

Summer hiring notice:
Due to summer vacations, we will begin the reviewing and interviewing process for this role from August. However, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

The role

At Mentimeter, strategy turns into product in our Areas – groups of teams led by a Product Director, with you owning the engineering alongside them. You'll be one of two Engineering Directors at Mentimeter, sitting in Area Leadership: you own how we build – technical direction, architecture, quality, and engineering leadership – and co-own your Areas' outcomes and trade-offs with your Product Director and Design Director peers.

In practice, that means leading 5–8 teams of typically 2–5 engineers each, through your Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers, building a product used by more than 300 million people.
This is a senior, high-impact role in a company growing into a multi-product business at global scale.

What this role is:

It is a technical leadership role.
Together with your Staff Engineers – the bar-setters who lead the craft inside the teams – you own technical direction and architectural coherence across your Areas: the standards for how we build, and an engineering-quality bar that holds. You set and evolve that technical strategy with them; it does not arrive from somewhere else.
It is also a business leadership role.
You reason about customer outcomes, capacity, and investment, not just engineering. Build-vs-borrow-vs-buy calls land on your desk, and we expect you to ground them in a business context.
It is a role where you lead through leaders.
Your job is to grow Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers who grow great engineers. If your instinct is to be the smartest engineer in the room, this will frustrate you.
It is not a delivery management role.
Delivery belongs to the teams, not to you or your Engineering Managers, and we place heavy trust in them to run it.
It is not a role where strategy is handed to you.
You grab ambiguity unfazed and create clarity for others, in a company that keeps changing shape as it grows.
It is not a hands-off role either.
This is not a role for leaders who think of themselves as engineering adjacent. You stay close enough to the technology to challenge and be challenged.

What you'll do:

Turn strategy into outcomes

Translate company, technology, and product strategy into clear team missions, boundaries, and success measures
Keep technology and product strategy tightly aligned: shared priorities, shared trade-offs, shared outcomes
Own the Areas' outcomes together with your Product and Design peers, from planning through delivery

Own how we build

Own technical direction and architectural coherence across your Areas – the systems hang together as teams move fast
Set the engineering-quality bar with your Staff Engineers
Move your Areas toward agentic development – make AI part of how every team builds, and own that shift as an outcome, not an experiment

Create the conditions for autonomous teams

Give teams unambiguous ownership, a clear mission, and known decision boundaries. That is what autonomy is built on
Build a native product-engineering culture where engineers participate in discovery and work from customer and business outcomes

Allocate capacity and investments

Allocate engineering capacity across teams, and rebalance as priorities change
Make trade-offs at Area level rather than inside individual teams, and decide where engineering effort creates the most value
Drive build-vs-borrow-vs-buy decisions with long-term business impact in mind. Budget, headcount, and tooling follow strategy

Lead the leaders

Coach and grow your Engineering Managers and the Areas' Staff Engineers, and hold them accountable for the growth of their engineers and systems
Build the next generation of engineering leadership through hiring, feedback, and honest development conversations

Keep delivery healthy

Balance speed, quality, and technical investment so the Areas deliver without heroics
Resolve cross-team and cross-Area dependencies before they become bottlenecks
Spot weak signals in team delivery and technical direction, and course-correct early
Make technical debt visible and deliberately managed, not discovered in firefights

What success looks like

Every team in your Areas can explain its mission, ownership, and success criteria – and has the autonomy to act on them
Engineering investments clearly ladder into product, technology, and company strategy.
The architecture stays coherent as teams move fast, and the engineering-quality bar holds across your Areas
Your Areas are visibly further along on agentic development – AI is part of how every team builds, and you can show the shift
Product and Design pull engineering into decisions early – because they want to, not because they have to
Your Engineering Managers grow visibly, and engineers' craft grows because of them
The Areas deliver against their goals, and hold that pace under pressure
Issues surface early; late-stage reversals and escalations are rare

How you lead, and how AI runs through it

You lead with heart and bravery: you care personally about people and decide courageously, in line with our leadership commitment. You balance care and challenge, supporting your leaders while holding a high bar. You multiply through others.
And you are AI-native. Not as an initiative, but as an instinct. AI runs through how you work, how you think, and how you lead – and you are actively rethinking what an engineering organization looks like when AI is part of how every team builds. We are working this out in practice at Mentimeter, and you will help set the patterns the rest of the company learns from.

We believe you have:

You were an excellent engineer before you were a leader: deep fluency in code, systems, and your domain, now extended into how AI changes all three. That foundation carried you into leading teams, and then into leading the leaders of teams
Five or more years of engineering leadership at scale: you have led Engineering Managers and senior staff across an organization of 50+ engineers, with a track record of growing them and the business
Experience owning engineering across multiple teams in a product company, ideally at Area or department level
Experience allocating capacity and making investment trade-offs across teams, not only within one
Strong product instincts: you work from user and business outcomes, not delivery tasks
A track record of owning technical direction and architecture across multiple teams, and keeping it coherent as they scale
Commercial judgment: you ground investment calls in business context
Experience leading through change: restructures, migrations, and ever-shifting priorities

It is beneficial if you have:

Experience from product-led B2B SaaS
Hands-on experience leading teams through the shift to AI-driven engineering
Experience reshaping organizations as they change along with their needs

Not Required:

Swedish is not required. Daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ nationalities
A cover letter is not required as part of your application

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 88,000-102,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.

AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it.
Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

jobs.description:
About 1Kosmos

1Kosmos is the leader in identity verification, providing a unified platform that combines identity verification and passwordless authentication into a single distributed identity cloud service. With 75M+ users, billions of verifications and authentications, and 3x growth, we're transforming how organizations verify and authenticate workers, customers, and citizens. We're FedRAMP High Authorized—the only FedRAMP High authorized, Kantara-certified Full Service NIST 800-63-3 digital identity wallet solution—and certified to the highest industry standards including FIDO2, ISO 27001, and SOC II Type 2. Recognized by Gartner as ranking highest for Workforce Use Cases in the 2025 Critical Capabilities for Identity Verification report, 1Kosmos is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, government, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, and retail. As a Series B company experiencing rapid growth, we're now building critical fraud detection capabilities to protect our customers and their users from evolving identity threats.

The Opportunity

At 1Kosmos, our leaders are active, builder-first contributors. We are looking for an engineering leader who stays close to the code—someone who enjoys diving into technical challenges, understanding system internals, and driving execution from the front lines through active participation in architectural design, code reviews, and hands-on problem-solving.

You possess an "always sleeveless" mindset: no task is too technical, no bug is too small, and no architecture is too complex for you to dive into. You will step into a cloud-agnostic microservices environment, gain deep context on what we've built, and actively drive execution, performance, security, and system evolution.

What You'll Do:

Lead from the Front: Manage, mentor, and elevate a mid-sized engineering team while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in code, system design, and infrastructure
Master Existing Architecture First: Take full ownership of existing architectures. Deeply understand the whybehind our current design decisions before making tactical shifts or introducing new paradigms
Build Real Agentic Systems: Work hands-on with our agentic stack (AWS Bedrock / Python / Node), going far beyond basic LLM prompts or chatbots. Open the hood to optimize agent workflows, orchestration, reliability, and security
Drive Performance & Security: Maintain a relentless focus on low latency, high throughput, platform resilience, and enterprise security across our cloud-agnostic microservices topology
Own Delivery & Reliability: Partner with product and QA leads to ensure clean, reliable, and zero-downtime deployments
Foster a Zero-Ego Culture: Build a collaborative environment where ownership is non-negotiable, and execution speaks louder than slides

Requirements

What We're Looking For

10+ years of software engineering experience with recent, hands-on engineering leadership (Director / VP level in high-growth B2B SaaS)
Core Microservices Stack: Deep, practical experience in Node.js (90% of our stack) alongside Java or GoLang
Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on mastery of containerized, cloud-agnostic environments (Kubernetes, AWS)
Applied Agentic Experience: Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing autonomous agents and agentic workflows (experience with AWS Bedrock is a huge plus)
Security-First Mindset: Deep appreciation for platform security, identity management, compliance, and secure software development practices
Leadership Style: Proven track record of both building 0-to-1 systems and taking ownership of mature, inherited codebases

Who Thrives Here:

Builders who love creating something from nothing and aren't afraid of rolling up their sleeves
Fast movers who navigate ambiguity with confidence and iterate at speed
Problem solvers who are energized by complex, evolving challenges
Collaborators who can influence without authority and build strong cross-functional relationships
Data enthusiasts who let evidence drive decisions, not opinions
Mission-driven professionals passionate about fighting fraud and protecting customers

Benefits

Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup

Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The VP of Engineering owns the architecture, software development, and technical execution that scale our product portfolio and customer delivery. This role leads the company’s engineering strategy, focusing on building high-performance teams, driving engineering velocity, and transitioning from independent product-led software to a unified, scalable platform. The VP of Engineering partners with product and business leadership to translate business goals into robust, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions. This is a senior engineering leadership role requiring both strategic technical vision and operational rigor. The ideal leader will build and nurture engineering talent, define technical standards, manage the software development lifecycle, and ensure our engineering function acts as a primary driver of growth and product quality.

ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, disciplined, accountable, transparent, aligned, and results oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

Platform architecture advances from connected products toward a managed platform, with clear ownership for shared services, APIs, integrations,     infrastructure, and technical dependencies across every major sub-product.
Engineering execution runs on a measurable operating rhythm, including roadmap commitments, release readiness, delivery reporting, priority tradeoff management, and clear accountability across platform, product, integration, and internal systems work.

Observability, reliability, and redundancy improve through defined production health metrics, monitoring coverage, incident response practices, infrastructure standards, and a roadmap for eliminating critical single points of failure as the platform scales.

OBJECTIVES

Implement and execute the engineering strategy to transition from our current portfolio of individual product-led software products to a cohesive, broader platform architecture over the next 12 months.
Drive high-performance engineering operations by embedding rigorous SDLC standards, CI/CD maturity, and developer-centric productivity metrics to support the platform transition.
Create clear ownership and execution rhythms across engineering, ensuring roadmap governance and cross-functional accountability for platform development.
Ensure product and platform investments are aligned to business priorities, measurable outcomes, and scalable customer-facing delivery.
Oversee the reliability, security, governance, and maintainability of critical technology systems.
Advance the company's data strategy and align with data product product owners, including client data products, analytics, MDM integration, and enterprise data foundations.
Create operating discipline across Technology through clear ownership, metrics, roadmap governance, execution rhythms, and cross-functional accountability.

COMPETENCIES

Deep experience in engineering execution, with a proven track record of transitioning from fragmented, individual product-led software to a unified, scalable platform architecture.
Strong leadership across multi-disciplinary teams, including engineering, product, data, analytics, IT, business operations, and external partners.
Ability to translate business goals into scalable technical architecture, clear engineering roadmaps, and high-performance team structures.
Strong judgment around build-vs-buy decisions, vendor strategy, security posture, platform scalability, and operational risk.
Experience creating technology operating models with clear ownership, delivery discipline, metrics, and accountability.
Ability to communicate clearly with executive, technical, operational, and client-facing stakeholders.
High ownership, high standards, and strong ability to develop leaders who can operate independently.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

BS/MS Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a highly quantitative field (e.g., Applied Mathematics, Data Science).
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Architecture, with at least 2 years in a Lead/Architectural role focused on analytical data delivery.
Demonstrated experience with complex data projects requiring significant data cleansing, imputation, and enrichment with third-party datasets (e.g., census, demographic data).

10X TOTAL REWARDS

Parental leave: 8 weeks fully paid (primary caregiver) / 4 weeks fully paid (secondary) + 1 month remote for both
Vacation and sick time that increases with tenure
Gym membership, 100% paid
Meal prep service discounts
Pet insurance through SPOT
Employee Assistance Program through Guardian
Professional development reimbursements for outside courses and certifications
10X Mentorship Program
$250K+ in internal education resources across Sales, Operations, Finance, People, and Marketing
Uncapped commission eligibility for all team members

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY 

As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce Cardone Ventures recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates and partners.
